findings.summary: Reuse the shared CMake cache path comparison and apply host case and separator rules, preserving case-sensitive Linux compiler paths.
Reuse setupEnvironment when constructing the Linux scene-build environment so dependency setup and scene builds share the selected compiler pair.
Share readable SDL composition targets across scene, sprite, and window presenters so backdrop filters never read a swapchain image.
Reuse the existing capture texture when UI capture already provides a readable composition target, avoiding an extra full-frame allocation and blit.
Remove the unused presentation UI-runtime alias after moving UI recording to encode.
Only remove temporary adapted HLSL for SPIR-V builds; DXIL builds create no adapted source.
Update browser harness comments to describe Linux Vulkan and visible capture behavior.
Classify multisampled storage textures once for register ordering, sidecar slots, and SPIR-V descriptors.
Reuse canonicalLocalAssetSource for filesystem discoveries in audio directory fetches and Canvas2D image packaging.
Derive transcode compression capabilities from the existing native uploadable format table, preserving the pinned loader selection.
Capture only the physics body identity in record lookups, avoiding copies of ownership fields.
Rewrite SPIR-V sampler uses in two shared scans with texture lookups instead of rescanning each shader per texture.
Retain custom-material shader recipes only in scenes with render tasks, avoiding shader and vertex-description storage in ordinary scenes.
Reuse existing custom-material pipelines when render-task attachments match, creating cached variants only for different formats or sample counts.
Share the SPIR-V instruction walker between descriptor and sparse-location binary regressions, including bounded instruction-length validation.
Centralize Dawn material image-lease and sampled-resource cleanup in its shared owner, removing repeated cleanup pairs.
Compact expired image-upload entries once and acquire strong references only for matching image keys.
Use hostOfflineShaderTarget in demo shipping so development and shipping share the host shader selection policy.
Compute the shipping triplet once per plan and share it across dependency profiles and scene configuration.
